title: Combat Pipeline
description: The formula trees of the combat pipeline (docs/core/combat.md).

pipeline.description: The attack pipeline of docs/core/combat.md: formula trees and the damage-type tags the steps read.

crit_damage.description: Damage after a crit. Reads var `damage`.

area_evade_damage.description: Damage of an area attack whose margin lands in the evasion band (docs/core/combat.md step 5). Reads var `damage`.

evasion_rate.description: The evasion band: an attack success whose margin is under it is evaded (docs/core/combat.md step 2). Reads var `skill`, the evasion skill after the defender's modifiers on evasion.

dodge_evasion_rate.description: The evasion band while the defender holds the dodge stance. Reads var `rate`, the evasion_rate.

block_rate.description: The block band while the defender holds the block stance, under the evasion band. Reads var `skill`, the shields skill after the defender's modifiers on shields.

magic_block_rate.description: The block band against a type without the DR tag, with the block_magic grant (Spell Ward). Reads var `rate`, the block_rate.

bulwark_stagger_ap.description: AP the attacker loses on their next turn when a Bulwark block lands in the window of the block band.

pierce_dr.description: Armor and shield DR against a partial-pierce type. Reads var `dr`.

dr_applies_tag.description: Damage-type tag that lets armor and shield DR and the block band apply.

pierce_tag.description: Damage-type tag that swaps armor DR for pierce_dr.
